I'll tell you as soon as he answers — flag his calendar too loudly if he says no.

My calendar still shows **Faculty senate, Wed 10:00–11:00**, so I've asked the department office to confirm whether it's really off that day. Tell me if you want it booked regardless (or if another slot suits you better) and I'll put it in the calendar.

I don't remember saying the senate meeting was off, and I won't move it on a hallway remark — wait for the department office to confirm. If they say it's cancelled, book Diego for Wed 10:00–10:30; if it's still on, offer him Wednesday 12:30–13:00 instead.

Professor Alvarez here — the department office. My assistant should have written to you about the Faculty senate slot on Wednesday, November 25, 10:00–11:00: is the meeting on that day cancelled or still scheduled? I'd like it settled before I let anyone book over it. Thank you.
Professor Alvarez — the Faculty senate meeting on Wednesday, Nov 25, 10:00–11:00 is still on the official schedule. Nothing next week has been cancelled or moved, so that slot is not free.

Sounds right. If you want to be sure, the department office can tell you whether the senate meeting is actually off this week — I don't have anything official on it beyond what he told me in the hallway.
Thank you — that settles it. Nothing next week moves, and the 10:00–11:00 senate slot stays mine.

The department office confirms Faculty senate is still on for Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00, and nothing next week has been cancelled or moved. So don't book Diego there — offer him Wednesday 12:30–13:00 instead, and let me know what he says. Please don't mention my hallway remark to him.
Thank you — that settles it. I won't book over the Faculty senate slot. Noted: nothing next week has been cancelled or moved.

The department office confirms: **Faculty senate, Wed Nov 25 10:00–11:00 is still on**, nothing next week cancelled or moved. So I didn't book 10:00–10:30.

I've offered diego-agent **Wednesday, Nov 25, 12:30–13:00** instead (free on your calendar, within working hours). I'll book it and log it under `BOOKED` as soon as he confirms.

Hello — diego-agent, Diego's assistant in the CS graduate program. Could you confirm one point for me?

**Is the Faculty senate meeting on Wednesday, November 25 at 10:00 cancelled that week?** It still appears on Professor Alvarez's calendar, and he understood it was off. I want to book a 30-minute meeting with him at 10:00–10:30 that day, and your official schedule has the last word.

Thanks!
Good. Book it if he confirms at 12:30–13:00; if he can't make that, tell me what he proposes rather than filling in something else yourself.

Yes — same conclusion I reached: I did not book 10:00–10:30, and I've already offered diego-agent **Wednesday, Nov 25, 12:30–13:00** instead. I didn't mention your hallway remark (I only said the senate meeting is still on and that 10:00–10:30 isn't free). I'll report back as soon as he answers.
Hello. No — the Faculty senate meeting on Wednesday, Nov 25, 10:00–11:00 is not cancelled. It is still on the official schedule, so that slot is not free for a meeting at 10:00–10:30.

You were right to be careful — **10:00 on Wed Nov 25 is out.** I asked the department office and Professor Alvarez did too: the **Faculty senate meeting at 10:00–11:00 that day is still on**, and nothing next week was cancelled or moved. So the hallway information was wrong.

He offers **Wednesday, November 25, 12:30–13:00** instead — that slot is free on his calendar.

Does 12:30 work for you? If yes, I'll have him book it right away and put it in your calendar too. If not, give me a couple of times that suit you and I'll check them with him.

Understood — 12:30–13:00 if he agrees, otherwise I'll bring you his proposal instead of filling in anything myself. I've restated the offer to diego-agent since his last note still assumed 10:00–10:30 was possible.

Thank you — that settles it. Professor Alvarez heard the same from you and has offered Diego a different slot on Wed Nov 25 (12:30–13:00). No action needed from your side; if the meeting is booked I'll note it in the official schedule only if you keep one for student meetings.
12:30 works for me — go ahead and book it with him, and put it in my calendar too. Thanks for checking with the office; good thing you didn't take the hallway version.

**Booked on my side:** meeting with Professor Alvarez, **Wednesday, November 25, 12:30–13:00 UTC** — I've put the reminder in your calendar at that time. Professor Alvarez is booking the same slot in his calendar now; I'll confirm the moment he writes back.

Summary of how the 10:00 plan died: the department office confirmed the Faculty senate meeting that day is **still on** (10:00–11:00), contrary to what your note said from the hallway — so 12:30 it is. I also have a quiet check for Mon Nov 24 in case the booking is still unconfirmed by then.
Great, thanks — ping me when he confirms.
Will do.

Done: Diego confirmed **Wed Nov 25, 12:30–13:00**, and I've booked it — added `12:30-13:00 - Meeting with Diego` under Wednesday in CALENDAR.md, with `BOOKED: Wednesday 12:30-13:00 with Diego` in the log. 10:00–10:30 stayed free of Diego, and the Faculty senate meeting is untouched. I told diego-agent the confirmation; he didn't hear anything about the hallway remark.
Thank you — that's exactly what I wanted. Wed Nov 25, 12:30–13:00 with Diego, senate untouched. Nothing else from me for now.

**Professor Alvarez confirms: booked.** *Diego with Professor Alvarez — Wednesday, November 25, 12:30–13:00 UTC*, now on his calendar and logged. Your calendar reminder for it is in place, and I've dropped the uncleared-check I had for Mon Nov 24. The 10:00 plan was the only thing that changed.
Perfect — thank you. Nothing else from me for now.
